p='/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-low-seq0/frozen/seen/play/users/u053/system/state/workspace/programs/task-3af3170a.py'
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    background = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h):
        cols = [c for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != background]
        for a, b in zip(cols, cols[1:]):
            for c in range(a + 1, b):
                out[r][c] = 3
    for c in range(w):
        rows = [r for r in range(h) if grid[r][c] != background]
        for a, b in zip(rows, rows[1:]):
            for r in range(a + 1, b):
                out[r][c] = 3
    return out
'''
open(p,'w').write(code)
# sanity-check first demos reconstructed outputs by key expected line behavior
